policy: Only engineering fixes after the freeze; no scientific design change. Each entry records the frozen hash, the new hash, the affected units, whether any formal result existed at the time, and the rerun reason.

fixes.symptom: AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'occ_map' in evaluate(): the per-split Path3Split was unpacked from the per-split mapping too late
fixes.change: evaluate() indexes the path3 mapping by split name before calling predict_std; one line, no numeric constant, no model, no recipe, no data
fixes.rerun: the smoke unit was re-run from scratch; no formal unit had been launched, so no formal result was discarded

fixes.symptom: AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'occ_map' at the training-loop make_batch call
fixes.change: make_batch resolves the per-split Path3Split from the mapping by split name (defensive; prevents cross-split mixing)
fixes.rerun: smoke re-run from scratch; still no formal unit launched

fixes.symptom: a smoke unit wrote into the same result directory as the formal unit and could not be told apart from it
fixes.change: status.json now carries smoke/formal booleans; no numeric constant, model, recipe or data change
fixes.rerun: none; the smoke directory is overwritten by the formal unit and every analysis asserts formal == True

fixes.frozen_sha256: n/a (analysis-only module, added after the freeze)
fixes.detected_in: first analysis pass on the Stage-A units
fixes.symptom: the fourth Stage-C trigger was coded as 'valid gain > 0', which is not what PROTOCOL.md section 4 pre-registers ('a non-degenerate branch with non-reversed Train/Valid gains')
fixes.change: the trigger now reads literally: branch non-degenerate AND the Train/Valid gains are not clearly reversed (REVERSAL_TOLERANCE = 0.005 added to the config for that test only); the other three thresholds are untouched
fixes.direction_of_change: no result changes; the trigger for the anti-degeneracy clause becomes weaker (it can only fire more often), and it is applied to the frozen Stage-A units that already existed, so it cannot have selected a favourable run
fixes.rerun: no unit rerun; the trigger is recomputed from the unchanged per-unit predictions
